Subject: Staged onboarding incentive schedule & MAP draft

Hi Megan / Aaron —

Thanks again for taking the time yesterday. As promised, attached is a fresh draft of a Mutual Action Plan (MAP) tailored to FinLytics' evaluation goals and timelines (redwood_MAP_v2.pdf). The high-level incentives we discussed are summarized below so procurement has a clean view of economics tied to milestones: 

- Pilot credit: 150k token equivalent (applied during POC stage) — redeemable during the 30-day evaluation window.
- Free trial extension: +30 days if acceptance tests (A/B latency and recall checks) are completed by the end of the first 45 days.
- Conversion pricing: if FinLytics converts to a 3-month reserved commitment within 60 days of pilot acceptance, we commit to a 15% unit discount on hosted inference for the first 3 months.
- Ramp incentive: additional one-time credit equal to 20% of pilot credits if you commit to a 6-month reserved plan within 30 days of pilot acceptance.

Two asks: 1) can procurement review the attached MAP and SOW draft (SOW-finlytics-draft.docx), and 2) can we lock a target date for pilot start the week of Jan 24th? If FinLytics signs the MAP by Jan 24 we can guarantee the ramp incentive and the conversion discount above.

I've copied our internal commercial lead (Rishi) and solutions engineer (Marcus) on the thread to keep alignment on acceptance criteria and the technical checklist. Happy to jump on a 30-min call to walk through the MAP line-by-line.

Folks —

Quick notes from the solutions side to make the acceptance criteria more measurable (this will help both teams avoid ambiguity during the MAP):

1) Acceptance tests (Pilot acceptance):
  - Latency: 95th percentile token latency under X model at <= 120ms for 2 concurrent UI flows.
  - Recall: baseline F1 on final prompt set >= 0.78 (we'll finalize the prompt suite in week 1).
  - Stability: end-to-end run with KV cache warmup across 3 sessions with no more than 1% error rate.

2) Data and logs: we'll provide a daily anonymized usage CSV and an audit-log export on request (we will document the retention window in the SOW).

3) Credit handling (commercial):
  - If FinLytics requests an extension due to scope change before pilot acceptance, we can allocate an extra 20% pilot credits as a one-time supplement (requires approval).
  - If the customer signs a 6-month reserved commitment within 30 days of pilot acceptance we can add an extra 20% credit (as Camila outlined).

I've attached the pricing-sheet-Q1-2027.xlsx with example math for the two commitment sizes. Recommend we make the 15% conversion discount mutually exclusive to the 6-month ramp incentive to keep math simple (i.e., either the 15% 3-month conversion discount OR the 6-month ramp credit + 10% discount — proposal below).

Attachment: [attachment: pricing-sheet-Q1-2027.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Megan / Aaron / Procurement —

Thanks for the quick feedback. We've updated the SOW to explicitly call out log retention and the acceptance export path (see SOW-finlytics-draft.docx). To be explicit on the incentives and how they map to the MAP milestones, here is the finalized schedule: 

Milestone A — Pilot start (week 1):
  - Deliverable: deployment to your staging region + baseline prompt suite uploaded.
  - Incentive: 150k pilot credits issued on kickoff.

Milestone B — Pilot acceptance (metric gates met, expected within 30–45 days):
  - Deliverable: signed acceptance form + performance report.
  - Incentive: redeemable pilot credits applied; if acceptance occurs by Jan 24, additional +10% credit bonus.

Milestone C — Conversion & Ramp options (within 30/60 days post-acceptance):
  Option 1: Convert to 3-month reserved within 60 days -> guaranteed 15% off hosted inference units for first 3 months (written into SOW).
  Option 2: Convert to 6-month reserved within 30 days -> one-time extra 20% credit on top of pilot credits + 10% unit discount (mutually exclusive with Option 1).

Credit rollover policy: unspent pilot credits do not automatically roll into paid months, but if you sign a reserved commitment within the conversion window Redwood can grant a discretionary credit equal to up to 25% of unused pilot credits applied to month 1. We'll record the exact number in the SOW.

Extension policy: the +30 day trial extension applies if delays are caused by Redwood or mutually agreed blockers. If delays stem from FinLytics scheduling changes, the extension will be considered case-by-case (we will not automatically extend without mutual agreement).

Next steps: I've uploaded the revised SOW and MAP to the HubSpot deal and created a DocuSign envelope for signature: https://www.docusign.com/sign/abcd-efgh. If procurement can confirm the contact to receive the DocuSign and the preferred billing entity, we will send immediately.

If we receive a signed MAP/SOW by EOD Jan 24 we will lock the Jan 24 acceptance bonus and the Option 2 ramp incentive language.
